title: Dedicated autoscaler: burst controls + utilization reporting enhancement (v48)
author: Anika Patel
summary: Enhance Dedicated autoscaler: smoother burst controls, improved utilization reporting, and rollout-safe telemetry
description:
Motivation: customers on Dedicated fleets have reported bursty traffic causing oscillations in tokenbucket-based autoscaling and poor visibility into short-term burst utilization. This PR introduces a smoothing option for burst tokens, adds percentiles and tail metrics to utilization reporting, and provides an opt-in rollout plan to minimize risk.

What changed: - Added tokenbucket_smoothing configurable parameters (window_ms, alpha) to dedicated/autoscaler config. - Emit burst_utilization.{p50,p90,p99,tail} and burst_throughput.time_series metrics for fleet-level dashboards. - Improve queueing estimator used by the autoscaler to account for transient KV cache warm-ups. - Added migration compatibility to ensure older config files are accepted. - Updated docs and infra manifests for rollout flags.

Checklist: - [x] Design review (ENG-1423) - [x] Unit + integration tests - [x] Staging canary run - [x] Observability dashboards updated - [x] Backwards-compatible config parsing

Rollout plan: feature gate 'burst_smoothing_v48' defaults to off. We will enable in staging for 48h, run perf canary (see linear ENG-2150) and then progressively enable on 10% of Dedicated fleets, monitor burst_utilization.p99 and request latency. Automatic rollback rule: if p99 tail latency increases > 5% for > 15 minutes, revert gate.

Notes: this change is additive and opt-in; no breaking changes expected. See linked Linear tickets ENG-1423 and ENG-2150 for design docs and canary dashboards.

review_comments: Liam Chen (review): Can you clarify how alpha interacts with existing burst tokens? Might be worth documenting expected behavior for alpha=1 and alpha=0.
Author reply (Anika): Alpha=1 is no smoothing (current behavior). Alpha=0 fully smooths to long-term average. Added explicit examples in docs and unit tests to show boundary cases.
Sofia Martinez (review): Observability LGTM but please ensure tagging includes fleet_id + region so dashboards can slice by fleet.
Author reply (Anika): Added 'fleet_id' and 'region' labels to burst metrics and updated dashboard queries.
Rajiv Singh (approval): Ran canary for 24h on staging fleet — p99 latency improved for bursty workload. Approving for gradual rollout.
release_notes: Added optional tokenbucket smoothing for Dedicated autoscaler and enhanced burst utilization metrics (p50/p90/p99/tail). Feature gated 'burst_smoothing_v48' — opt-in rollout. Improvements reduce autoscaler oscillations for bursty traffic and provide better telemetry for fleet-level dashboards.
